'''2022 MPC Kessling + Arlandson DS Shadow Collective''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kessling + Arlandson]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kessling + Arlandson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Shadow Collective / You Know Who I Answer To|V13-D-shadowcollective.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Shadow Collective Arlandson DS 2022.txt |Download]]
